question: Assess 3M's litigation reserve adequacy.
reviewer_notes: Replaced the adequacy judgement with what the filing actually discloses.
reason_escalated: The question asks me to state whether 3M's litigation reserves are adequate. The filings do not make an adequacy determination — they explicitly say the opposite: for Combat Arms Earplugs, 3M states no liability has been recorded because any liability is "not probable and reasonably estimable" and the company "is not able to estimate a possible loss or range of possible loss at this time" [E1]. For other product liability matters, the company only says recorded amounts are "not material" and that it cannot estimate losses in excess of established accruals [E2]. Neither statement is an adequacy judgement — they are disclaimers of estimability. Asserting adequacy (or inadequacy) would not be grounded in the text. Requesting review before finalizing this paragraph.
